description: This file contains declarations and documentation for the interface between the ADB (Android Debug Bridge) API and the AdbWinUsbApi DLL on Windows. It defines a function prototype for instantiating a WinUsb interface, managing compatibility with legacy drivers and the WinUsb API.

classes.name: AdbInterfaceObject
classes.description: Ongoing occurrence in the function pointer typedef; represents the interface object instantiated by the API

methods.name: InstantiateWinUsbInterface
methods.description: A pointer type definition for a function that instantiates a WinUsb interface object given a device path
